text.en: Hello! Is this Windrider Camp? My map has more stains than landmarks.
text.zh-CN: 你好！这里是风骑营地吗？我的地图上，污渍可比路标多。

text.en: It is. I'm Dulcinea. Keep your voice down; travelers haven't been making friends here lately.
text.zh-CN: 是的，我叫杜尔西内娅。小声些吧，最近来的旅人，可没留下什么好印象。

text.en: Anything a traveler should know?
text.zh-CN: 旅人来这里，有什么要留意的？

text.en: This is my home. People here are tired of strangers asking about buried treasure. Please don't give them another reason to worry.
text.zh-CN: 这里是我的家。大家已经厌烦了那些打听地下宝藏的陌生人，别再让他们担心了。

text.en: This is my home. People here are tired of strangers asking about buried treasure. Please don't give them another reason to worry.
text.zh-CN: 这里是我的家。大家已经厌烦了那些打听地下宝藏的陌生人，别再让他们担心了。

text.en: Dulcinea? It's late. Are you going somewhere?
text.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅？这么晚了，你要去哪儿？

text.en: Just out. The person I hoped would choose me has chosen someone else. I can wish them well tomorrow. Tonight, I need some air.
text.zh-CN: 出去走走。我盼望的那个人，已经选了别人。明天，我也许能祝福他们。今晚，我想先透口气。

text.en: You shouldn't have to walk out there alone.
text.zh-CN: 你不该独自走进夜里。

text.en: I don't know what I need. Please, give me a moment.
text.zh-CN: 我也不知道自己需要什么。请让我静一静。

text.en: Dulcinea! Those travelers aren't here to ask for directions.
text.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅！那些旅人，可不像是来问路的。

text.en: Watch out! They're after me!
text.zh-CN: 小心！他们是冲我来的！

text.en: That Meteor Sigil of yours is impressive. Remind me not to stand under it.
text.zh-CN: 你的陨星符术真厉害。下次记得提醒我，别站在落点下面。

text.en: I taught her. And you can stop admiring my lessons long enough to explain yourself.
text.zh-CN: 那是我教的。夸完我的学生，也该说说你的来意了。

text.en: Cardenio! They wanted the treasure. Our friend helped me.
text.zh-CN: 卡德尼奥！那些人想找宝藏，是这位朋友帮了我。

text.en: I was passing through. The ambush made a rather poor first impression.
text.zh-CN: 我只是路过。这场伏击，让这里的第一印象稍微差了点。

text.en: Passing through, are you? Show me whether you can fight as well as you can talk.
text.zh-CN: 只是路过？那就让我看看，你的本领是不是和嘴一样厉害。

text.en: Must every introduction involve a duel?
text.zh-CN: 难道每次见面，都一定得先打一架吗？

text.en: Your student handled herself beautifully. I'll happily lose the argument and keep the bruises I already have.
text.zh-CN: 您的学生应付得很出色。道理算您赢，淤青就别再给我添了。

text.en: Hmph. A traveler who knows when to stop. Come along, Dulcinea.
text.zh-CN: 哼，还知道适可而止。走吧，杜尔西内娅。

text.en: That was clever. You may be the first stranger he's met without a second fight.
text.zh-CN: 你真有办法。你也许是第一个，没跟他再打一场的陌生人。

text.en: Until next time.
text.zh-CN: 我们下次再见。

text.en: Stand back, villains! Your humble tents do not deceive Don Quixote!
text.zh-CN: 恶徒退后！几顶朴素帐篷，可骗不过堂吉诃德！

text.en: They're families, not villains! Your companions have already hurt someone!
text.zh-CN: 他们是一家家过日子的人，不是恶徒！跟着你的人，已经伤人了！

text.en: I take it the welcoming committee has changed.
text.zh-CN: 看来，迎宾队伍换人了。

text.en: He stormed into camp with those treasure hunters. Please help me stop them.
text.zh-CN: 他带着那些寻宝人闯进营地。请帮我阻止他们。

text.en: I'm standing with Dulcinea. Put down the sword, Sir Knight.
text.zh-CN: 我站在杜尔西内娅这边。放下剑吧，骑士先生。

text.en: The knight has fled. Why were they so determined to find you?
text.zh-CN: 那位骑士跑了。他们为什么非要找到你不可？

text.en: My parents had a map of Windmill Warrens. Treasure hunters followed them here. My parents didn't survive.
text.zh-CN: 我的父母曾有一张风车地宫的地图。寻宝人一路追到这里，我的父母再也没能回来。

text.en: I'm sorry.
text.zh-CN: 我很遗憾。

text.en: They never found the map. Now they think I can lead them to the treasure.
text.zh-CN: 他们始终没找到地图。现在，他们以为我能带他们找到宝藏。

text.en: Dulcinea, I'll come with you. We can face them together.
text.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅，我和你一起去。我们一起面对他们。

text.en: Thank you. Let's go.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢。走吧。

text.en: Their tracks led us here. Windmill Warrens... I thought it was only a story.
text.zh-CN: 他们的足迹通向这里。风车地宫……我一直以为，那只是个故事。

text.en: Someone's fighting up ahead.
text.zh-CN: 前面有人在打斗。

text.en: You should have stayed away!
text.zh-CN: 你们本来就不该来！

text.en: Stop! Those people are from my camp!
text.zh-CN: 住手！那是我们营地的人！

text.en: Dulcinea, look out!
text.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅，小心！

text.en: Father Perez! No!
text.zh-CN: 佩雷斯神父！不！

text.en: That spell... Cardenio? Is that you?
text.zh-CN: 那个法术……卡德尼奥？是你吗？

text.en: Cardenio was the name I hid behind. Roque Guinart is the man they banished.
text.zh-CN: 卡德尼奥，是我藏身时用的名字。他们放逐的那个人，叫罗克·吉纳特。

text.en: Why didn't you tell me?
text.zh-CN: 你为什么不告诉我？

text.en: I taught you to distrust strangers. I should have taught myself to let old grudges go.
text.zh-CN: 我教你提防陌生人，却没能教会自己，放下旧日的仇怨。

text.en: Please. Stay with me.
text.zh-CN: 求你了，别离开我。

text.en: Perez saved you. Remember him for that. As for me... don't mistake bitterness for wisdom.
text.zh-CN: 佩雷斯救了你，要记住他的这份好。至于我……别把怨恨，错当成智慧。

text.en: My teacher. Father Perez. Gone. I don't know where to go now.
text.zh-CN: 老师，佩雷斯神父，都不在了。我不知道，接下来还能去哪儿。

text.en: You don't have to decide your whole future today. Just the next stretch of road. We'd be glad to share it.
text.zh-CN: 不用今天就想好一生。先想下一段路吧。我们愿意陪你走。

text.en: And what happens when I don't feel brave?
text.zh-CN: 要是我没那么勇敢了呢？

text.en: Then one of us carries the bags. That's what a party is for.
text.zh-CN: 那就换我们来背行李。结伴，不就是为了这个吗？

text.en: All right. But my horse gets a say in the route.
text.zh-CN: 好吧，不过去哪儿，我的马也得有一票。

text.en: Of course. The only one of us with four sensible feet.
text.zh-CN: 当然。我们当中，也只有它，脚踏实地得最彻底。

text.en: Time to practice together. If we both shout 'I've got this', one of us still needs to watch the flank.
text.zh-CN: 该一起练练了。就算两个人都喊“交给我”，也总得有一个记得看侧翼。

text.en: The Cardinal requests your ledger. His request comes with five swords.
text.zh-CN: 枢机主教要你的账册。这份请求，附带五把剑。

text.en: Tell him to make an appointment. Preferably after I've left.
text.zh-CN: 请他先预约。最好约在我离开之后。

text.en: I'm guessing this isn't a bookkeeping dispute.
text.zh-CN: 我猜，这不只是记账上的争执。

text.en: Milady de Winter. You interrupted a remarkably rude business meeting.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄·德温特。你打断了一场格外无礼的商谈。

text.en: Does every meeting here end with swords?
text.zh-CN: 这里的商谈，都用剑收尾吗？

text.en: Only the informal ones. A courier is being held at the Cardinal's Tower. I want him out.
text.zh-CN: 只有非正式商谈才这样。一名信使被关在枢机塔，我要把他救出来。

text.en: Come along. You clearly know this business better than I do.
text.zh-CN: 一起走吧。这门生意你显然比我熟。

text.en: A useful arrangement. Take this Threefold Swordplay manual; try not to fold it into a hat.
text.zh-CN: 这安排不错。拿上这本三段剑术手册，别把它折成帽子。

text.en: A letter from Grimm?
text.zh-CN: 格林的信？

text.en: Come see me.
text.zh-CN: 回来见我。

text.en: Concise. He must be saving ink for the stories.
text.zh-CN: 真简短。他一定把墨水留给故事了。

text.en: Field note: visiting Grimm advances the world story. Some unfinished encounters may close permanently. Finish what matters to you and save before returning.
text.zh-CN: 旅途提示：回访格林会推进世界剧情，一些未完成的事件可能永久关闭。先完成你在意的路线，返回前记得保存。

text.en: D'Artagnan. At last, a visitor worth arresting.
text.zh-CN: 达达尼昂，总算来了位值得逮捕的客人。

text.en: I was about to feel terribly important.
text.zh-CN: 我差点就以为自己是什么大人物了。

text.en: Rochefort, release the courier. We can spare everyone a great deal of trouble.
text.zh-CN: 罗什福尔，放了那名信使，大家都能少些麻烦。

text.en: The trouble is already on the payroll. Guards!
text.zh-CN: 麻烦已经领了薪水。卫兵！

text.en: Right. No visitor's pass, then.
text.zh-CN: 明白了，今天办不了访客证。

text.en: Enjoy your rescue. I'll arrange a less convenient reunion.
text.zh-CN: 好好庆祝吧。下次重逢，我会安排得没这么方便。

text.en: He really does book every meeting in advance.
text.zh-CN: 他还真是什么见面都要预约。

text.en: The courier is free. Take these training guides, and watch the caravan; Rochefort holds a grudge remarkably well.
text.zh-CN: 信使自由了。这些教材给你，之后留意营地。罗什福尔记仇的本事一流。

text.en: This time, the caravan and its secrets come with me.
text.zh-CN: 这一次，商队和它的秘密都得跟我走。

text.en: You keep saying that. It's becoming an expensive habit.
text.zh-CN: 你总这么说。这习惯可不便宜。

text.en: There are rather a lot of them.
text.zh-CN: 他们来的人，还真不少。

text.en: Then you'll want another sword. D'Artagnan, at your service.
text.zh-CN: 那你们就需要多一把剑。达达尼昂，愿意效劳。

text.en: Good timing. We were running short of dramatic entrances.
text.zh-CN: 来得正好，我们正缺一次漂亮的登场。

text.en: That was not how this operation was budgeted.
text.zh-CN: 这场行动的预算，可不是这么做的。

text.en: Consider it a revision. I'm staying with this company.
text.zh-CN: 就当修改预算了。我会留在这支队伍。

text.en: We could use your experience. And that sword lesson.
text.zh-CN: 正需要你的经验，还有那堂剑术课。

text.en: Halt! Official ferry toll. Very official. We've made a sign.
text.zh-CN: 站住！正式渡口收费。非常正式，我们还写了牌子。

text.en: I held the sign while it dried.
text.zh-CN: 牌子晾干时，是我负责扶着的。

text.en: Impressive credentials. Who appointed you?
text.zh-CN: 资历真不错。谁任命你们的？

text.en: We took a vote. Four in favor.
text.zh-CN: 我们投过票，四票赞成。

text.en: No one opposed. Excellent turnout.
text.zh-CN: 无人反对，投票率很高。

text.en: I'd like to inspect your permit before you inspect my purse.
text.zh-CN: 在你们检查我的钱包之前，我想先检查你们的许可。

prompt.en: How do you answer the toll collectors?

text.en: Your permit appears to have expired.
text.zh-CN: 你们的许可，好像过期了。

text.en: A temporary administrative setback!
text.zh-CN: 只是暂时的行政挫折！

text.en: I told you we needed a larger sign.
text.zh-CN: 早说了，牌子得做大一点。

text.en: Four grown men charging travelers for a river they don't own. How enterprising.
text.zh-CN: 四个大人，替不属于自己的河收费。真会做生意。

text.en: Blue Fairy! This traveler wants the paired seals!
text.zh-CN: 蓝仙女！这位旅人想抢那对印记！

text.en: I wanted a receipt. The story seems to be growing.
text.zh-CN: 我只是想要张收据，事情怎么越传越大？

text.en: The seals stay with us. You can argue with my wooden sword.
text.zh-CN: 印记得留下。想讲道理，可以先问我的木剑。

text.en: Pinocchio, be careful. We still don't know this traveler.
text.zh-CN: 匹诺曹，小心些，我们还不认识这位旅人。

text.en: You've made your point. If it's the paired seals you want, let Pinocchio be.
text.zh-CN: 你已经证明本事了。如果你要的是这对印记，别再伤害匹诺曹。

prompt.en: What will you do about the paired seals?

text.en: Keep them. I came for the ferry, not somebody else's keepsake.
text.zh-CN: 你们留着吧。我是来坐船的，不是来抢别人的纪念物。

text.en: Then perhaps we should have started with introductions.
text.zh-CN: 那么，我们也许该先自我介绍。

text.en: Pinocchio. These seals are supposed to make their keeper unbeatable.
text.zh-CN: 我叫匹诺曹。听说这对印记，能让持有者天下无敌。

text.en: We've just conducted a fairly thorough test of that claim.
text.zh-CN: 刚才那场，算是相当充分的实测了。

text.en: Together they say, 'Kindness outlasts force.' Oh. That may explain the results.
text.zh-CN: 合起来写的是：善意胜过蛮力。哦，难怪刚才会那样。

text.en: A lesson worth keeping, even without a trophy.
text.zh-CN: 即使没有战利品，这课也值得记住。

text.en: Captain Orlando, royal collector. Hand over the seals.
text.zh-CN: 皇家征收官，奥兰多队长。交出印记。

text.en: You may have them. They don't do what you think.
text.zh-CN: 可以给你，它们没有你想的那种本事。

text.en: Then I'll take the witnesses, too.
text.zh-CN: 那证人也一并带走。

text.en: Ah. Another permit problem.
text.zh-CN: 啊，又是一桩手续问题。

data.reason: Lost the original solo finale; restore a full pre-encounter export and train normally.

text.en: Halt! Official ferry toll. Very official. We've made a sign.
text.zh-CN: 站住！正式渡口收费。非常正式，我们还写了牌子。

text.en: I held the sign while it dried.
text.zh-CN: 牌子晾干时，是我负责扶着的。

text.en: Impressive credentials. Who appointed you?
text.zh-CN: 资历真不错。谁任命你们的？

text.en: We took a vote. Four in favor.
text.zh-CN: 我们投过票，四票赞成。

text.en: No one opposed. Excellent turnout.
text.zh-CN: 无人反对，投票率很高。

text.en: I'd like to inspect your permit before you inspect my purse.
text.zh-CN: 在你们检查我的钱包之前，我想先检查你们的许可。

prompt.en: How do you answer the toll collectors?

text.en: Your permit appears to have expired.
text.zh-CN: 你们的许可，好像过期了。

text.en: A temporary administrative setback!
text.zh-CN: 只是暂时的行政挫折！

text.en: I told you we needed a larger sign.
text.zh-CN: 早说了，牌子得做大一点。

text.en: Four grown men charging travelers for a river they don't own. How enterprising.
text.zh-CN: 四个大人，替不属于自己的河收费。真会做生意。

text.en: Blue Fairy! This traveler wants the paired seals!
text.zh-CN: 蓝仙女！这位旅人想抢那对印记！

text.en: I wanted a receipt. The story seems to be growing.
text.zh-CN: 我只是想要张收据，事情怎么越传越大？

text.en: The seals stay with us. You can argue with my wooden sword.
text.zh-CN: 印记得留下。想讲道理，可以先问我的木剑。

text.en: Pinocchio, be careful. We still don't know this traveler.
text.zh-CN: 匹诺曹，小心些，我们还不认识这位旅人。

text.en: You've made your point. If it's the paired seals you want, let Pinocchio be.
text.zh-CN: 你已经证明本事了。如果你要的是这对印记，别再伤害匹诺曹。

prompt.en: What will you do about the paired seals?

text.en: Keep them. I came for the ferry, not somebody else's keepsake.
text.zh-CN: 你们留着吧。我是来坐船的，不是来抢别人的纪念物。

text.en: Then perhaps we should have started with introductions.
text.zh-CN: 那么，我们也许该先自我介绍。

text.en: Pinocchio. These seals are supposed to make their keeper unbeatable.
text.zh-CN: 我叫匹诺曹。听说这对印记，能让持有者天下无敌。

text.en: We've just conducted a fairly thorough test of that claim.
text.zh-CN: 刚才那场，算是相当充分的实测了。

text.en: Together they say, 'Kindness outlasts force.' Oh. That may explain the results.
text.zh-CN: 合起来写的是：善意胜过蛮力。哦，难怪刚才会那样。

text.en: A lesson worth keeping, even without a trophy.
text.zh-CN: 即使没有战利品，这课也值得记住。

text.en: Captain Orlando, royal collector. Hand over the seals.
text.zh-CN: 皇家征收官，奥兰多队长。交出印记。

text.en: You may have them. They don't do what you think.
text.zh-CN: 可以给你，它们没有你想的那种本事。

text.en: Then I'll take the witnesses, too.
text.zh-CN: 那证人也一并带走。

text.en: Ah. Another permit problem.
text.zh-CN: 啊，又是一桩手续问题。

text.en: Stand back, villains! Your humble tents do not deceive Don Quixote!
text.zh-CN: 恶徒退后！几顶朴素帐篷，可骗不过堂吉诃德！

text.en: They're families, not villains! Your companions have already hurt someone!
text.zh-CN: 他们是一家家过日子的人，不是恶徒！跟着你的人，已经伤人了！

text.en: I take it the welcoming committee has changed.
text.zh-CN: 看来，迎宾队伍换人了。

text.en: He stormed into camp with those treasure hunters. Please help me stop them.
text.zh-CN: 他带着那些寻宝人闯进营地。请帮我阻止他们。

text.en: I'm standing with Dulcinea. Put down the sword, Sir Knight.
text.zh-CN: 我站在杜尔西内娅这边。放下剑吧，骑士先生。

text.en: The knight has fled. Why were they so determined to find you?
text.zh-CN: 那位骑士跑了。他们为什么非要找到你不可？

text.en: My parents had a map of Windmill Warrens. Treasure hunters followed them here. My parents didn't survive.
text.zh-CN: 我的父母曾有一张风车地宫的地图。寻宝人一路追到这里，我的父母再也没能回来。

text.en: I'm sorry.
text.zh-CN: 我很遗憾。

text.en: They never found the map. Now they think I can lead them to the treasure.
text.zh-CN: 他们始终没找到地图。现在，他们以为我能带他们找到宝藏。

text.en: Do you know what's in Windmill Warrens?
text.zh-CN: 你知道风车地宫里有什么吗？

text.en: No. My parents never told me. The treasure hunters refuse to believe that.
text.zh-CN: 不知道，父母从没告诉过我。那些寻宝人，却怎么都不肯相信。

text.en: Then someone should find out before more people get hurt.
text.zh-CN: 那就该有人查清楚，别再让更多人受伤。

text.en: I'm going after them. Take care of yourself.
text.zh-CN: 我要追上他们。你自己保重。

text.en: Windmill Warrens. The knight's trail really did lead somewhere.
text.zh-CN: 风车地宫。那位骑士的足迹，还真通向了一个地方。

text.en: Another treasure hunter! You won't leave with what you came for.
text.zh-CN: 又一个寻宝人！你休想带着想要的东西离开。

text.en: I was hoping for directions. Apparently, it's an ambush.
text.zh-CN: 我本来想问个路。看来，这里更流行伏击。

text.en: I've seen those spells before. You taught Dulcinea, didn't you?
text.zh-CN: 这些法术，我见过。你教过杜尔西内娅，对吗？

text.en: Cardenio! What happened to you?
text.zh-CN: 卡德尼奥！你怎么了？

text.en: Roque Guinart. That's my real name. I should have told you long ago.
text.zh-CN: 罗克·吉纳特，那才是我的本名。我早就该告诉你。

text.en: You hurt my teacher. Get away from him!
text.zh-CN: 你伤了我的老师。离他远点！

text.en: I can't beat you. What do you want?
text.zh-CN: 我打不过你。你到底想要什么？

text.en: Answers. What is everyone risking their lives for?
text.zh-CN: 一个答案。大家冒着生命危险，到底在找什么？

text.en: Shelves. Old instruments. Books. The conquerors took the gold long ago and left their idea of civilization behind.
text.zh-CN: 书架，旧乐器，还有书。征服者早就带走了黄金，留下他们所谓的文明。

text.en: My parents died for an empty treasury?
text.zh-CN: 我的父母，就为了一个空荡荡的宝库而死？

text.en: For a rumor. A rumor is much harder to bury than gold.
text.zh-CN: 为了一场传言。传言，可比黄金更难掩埋。

text.en: Come home with me, please.
text.zh-CN: 请跟我回家吧。

text.en: Not yet. There are things I still have to settle.
text.zh-CN: 还不行。我还有未了的事情。

text.en: Then I'll go back alone. Take care, traveler.
text.zh-CN: 那我先独自回去。旅人，你也保重。

text.en: A book of old poems. Not gold, but it deserves a reader. I'll take it.
text.zh-CN: 一本旧诗集。虽然不是黄金，也值得有人翻开。我带上它吧。

text.en: Still searching, Sir Knight? The warrens hold old books, not gold.
text.zh-CN: 骑士先生，还在找吗？地宫里只有旧书，没有黄金。

text.en: Then I have charged across half the desert for... a library?
text.zh-CN: 这么说，我纵横半片沙漠，竟然只是为了……一间图书室？

text.en: Not your worst charge. But the people in camp deserve an apology.
text.zh-CN: 还不算你最糟的一次冲锋。不过，营地的人们，值得你道个歉。

text.en: A knight should put things right. If someone could point me in the right direction.
text.zh-CN: 骑士应当弥补过失。只要，有人能给我指对方向。

outcomes.note: Normal difficulty; actual reward, equipment, mastery, spell study, formation, and save reload verified.
Ending and rewards reached, but the required final deployment was not enforced. This is NOT complete combat or difficulty validation. The host defect remains unresolved.
First two fights won twice; the original solo finale lost twice. Pinocchio has NOT been recruited. Blue Fairy is a story ally.
